label_scope: Independently source-reviewed partial positives. No retrieval calls, scoring implementation, observed rankings or benchmark outputs used to select queries or labels.

contract.positive_metric: Hit@5 and MRR@5 over listed known-positive IDs; not complete precision/recall.
contract.negative_metric: Nongating out-of-domain diagnostic: report returned IDs/count separately; semantic absence does not imply lexical zero matches. Operational no-match and incompatible-filter gates are separate unchanged-contract checks, not these cases.
contract.delivery: Listed required_resource_suffixes are minimum positive anchors, not the complete required set. Audit all resources in the pinned indexed_skill required set, including references/licenses, plus matching revision. Distinguish retrieval miss, budget omission, and incomplete-resource delivery.
contract.heldout: Do not reveal heldout wording, labels or family details to implementer until candidate runtime/code hash freeze.
contract.limitations: Twelve deliberately selected diagnostic positives, two easy out-of-domain controls; no representativeness, production generalization or agent efficacy claim. Family disjointness is a manually chosen intent taxonomy, not universal independence.
